Mark Zuckerberg’s congressional hearings pulled back the curtain on how platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, and X (Twitter) are shaping the minds of millions. But beyond privacy concerns and mental health crises lies something far deeper. Could the relentless drive for self-promotion, viral fame, and digital validation be preparing minds to embrace an even darker system—the mark of the beast? This end-time system is centered on self rather than God. As addictive algorithms train users to crave constant attention, movements like WitchTok are flooding feeds with witchcraft, magic, and spiritual deception. Is the wrong use of social media quietly conditioning a generation to accept the mark without question?
